entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Planar portals originally created by Kaldheim's World Tree and later by New Phyrexia's Invasion Tree, now the main way to travel between planes.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Phyrexians created Omenpaths with Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event after which Omenpaths became the main means of planar travel.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane where Omenpaths occur naturally.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Kaldheim's tree on which the realms shift.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: New Phyrexia's tree that creates Omenpaths.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Used by Phyrexians to create Omenpaths for their troops.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Planeswalker who located Ixalan through Omenpaths in under a year.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon of Ravnica who studies Omenpaths and runs the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who built a way to transmit information through Omenpaths with Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who regards Omenpaths with disdain.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who regards Omenpaths with disdain.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective who investigated the murders and uncovered the Firemind's plans.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Contracted with Proft to assist the Firemind.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: One of Niv-Mizzet's agents, who died in a string of murders.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A Fomori child who can see the endpoint of every Omenpath.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City on Avishkar with stable Omenpaths, becoming a center of Multiversal trade.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: Governing body opening embassies on various planes.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane colonized through Omenpaths and kept in check by the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: Private mercenary group keeping outlaws in check on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Strixhaven student who discusses the Vorzani Conjecture.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane whose city Ghirapur gained stable Omenpaths; sees Ravnica as its chief rival.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Niv-Mizzet runs the Omenpath Project.

events.summary: The Phyrexians create Omenpaths with Realmbreaker to transport troops in seedpods.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Phyrexians created Omenpaths with Realmbreaker to transport their troops in seedpods.

events.summary: After the Invasion, Omenpaths become a lasting phenomenon enabling planar travel for non-planeswalkers.
events.quote: After the Invasion, these new Omenpaths have become a lasting Multiversal phenomenon.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet studies the Omenpaths and employs agents across the Ravnican guilds.
events.quote: The Firemind began to study the portals and secretly employed agents across the Ravnican guilds to facilitate his research.

events.summary: Alquist Proft investigates a string of murders and uncovers the Firemind's plans.
events.quote: Following a string of murders, including the death of one of Niv-Mizzet’s agents, Kylox , the detective Alquist Proft began investigating evidence that uncovered the Firemind’s plans.

events.summary: Proft and Etrata are contracted to assist the Omenpath Project.
events.quote: Proft and Etrata were contracted to assist the Firemind with his "Omenpath Project."

events.summary: People settle Thunder Junction via Omenpaths.
events.quote: A myriad of people and cultures began to come through the Omenpaths and settle the uninhabited plane like the nomadic Atiin .

events.summary: Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet test a relay tower on Thunder Junction.
events.quote: it became the test site of Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet's relay tower project to develop a way to communicate through the Omenpaths.

events.summary: Ghirapur holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix to showcase Avishkar.
events.quote: a widely advertised multiplanar racing event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held at least a year after the Omenpaths opened.

relations.note: Built a way to transmit information through Omenpaths.
relations.quote: Niv-Mizzet and Ral Zarek were able to construct a way to transmit information through Omenpaths

relations.note: Avishkar recognizes Ravnica as chief rival.
relations.quote: In this effort, Avishkar has come to recognize Ravnica as its chief rival.
